note: No director brief existed in the repo (agent-digests/ was absent), so I picked the highest-leverage PvP change from the code, honouring the lead's BOTH-weapon-families decision. studio/engineer-2026-08-30 already existed on the remote (tactical + stamina commit); this branch is cherry-picked on top of it rather than force-pushed over it.

changes.what: Added GUARD config, pure deflectsProjectile() cone test, guarding state and a blended guard view-model pose.
changes.why: Melee had zero interaction with projectiles, so the saber had no answer to ranged. Guard makes the two weapon families a real rock-paper-scissors.

changes.what: update() accepts optional { onDeflect }; a bounce reflects velocity, reassigns owner/team, scales damage and refreshes life. deflected flag reset on spawn.
changes.why: Projectiles previously had one outcome vs a player: damage. Needed a hook so a defender can swat a shot back. Signature stays backwards compatible.

changes.what: STAMINA.guardDrain (16/s), deflectCost (12), guardFloor (8); Stamina.canGuard() and Stamina.spend(cost).
changes.why: Guard must cost something or a saber player turtles a projectile team out of the round. Reuses the stamina pool that landed earlier today instead of inventing a second resource.

changes.what: New _tryDeflect(); right mouse drives guarding through saber.update(); guard drains stamina while held and each swat spends deflectCost; hitmarker, spark burst and toast.
changes.why: Wires the mechanic to real input, the live projectile loop and the resource, local player only, no friendly-fire deflects.

changes.what: 6 geometry checks for the guard cone (front-only, in-reach, closing-velocity, swing arc wider than guard arc).
changes.why: deflectsProjectile() is pure, so its behaviour is cheap to lock down before balance tuning starts.

tests.stamina arithmetic: 8 deflects from a full bar, canGuard() false at 4

directives_done: BOTH weapon families interact: saber guard deflects incoming projectiles back at the thrower
Counterplay stays symmetric: front-only 3m cone, wider on swing, guard breakable by volume of fire, flanking still wins
Guard priced against the existing stamina pool rather than a new resource
Readable combat: distinct guard pose, spark burst, hitmarker and toast
challenge_for_mikel: Are 8 deflects per stamina bar too generous? After one playtest, tune deflectCost (punish spam) vs guardDrain (punish holding).
